namuci.p: [Na+muca(mocane)+i] (pu) CL=7 Na Muccati. Na+muca+ina. Thoma. Namuci-saddā concern both Māranata (devaputtamāra and kāmanata(kilesamāra). In Dhāna, Sya- although separately explains Māranata and kāmanata, in Ṭīkā, explains these two are the same. See - Dhāna. Dhāna,ṭī 42-3. Namuci-saṃ, Namui-prā)]. (1) Māranata(Devaputtamāra). (A) One who is not liberated from unwholesome dhammas. (B) He overwhelms them, they are wanting to escape his realm. (C) He handles and applies unwholesome people. (D) He handles the way that is beneficial for any living beings. (E) He makes them not liberate from the cycle of suffering. (2) Kāma Deva.
pn: Namuci. A name for Māra (q.v.), given because he does not allow either gods or men to escape (na muci) from his clutches, but works them harm. Snp-a.ii.386.
a: [န+မုစ(မောစနေ)+ဣ။
